note: one parameter per scenario, each with its own compare; now_us is the uptime each step runs at; a read with no fresh source is null (no extrapolation); integers compare exactly

scenarios.name: rank_handover
scenarios.note: test_databoard.py: rank 0 answers while fresh; past its 50 ms window the fresh rank 1 takes over; rank() and fresh_below() per source

scenarios.name: vector_passthrough
scenarios.note: a single provider of a vector: passed through

scenarios.name: shared_window
scenarios.note: test_databoard.py: the primary tier timeout governs every channel; the backup declared 5 s and is used only while fresh within the primary 20 ms

scenarios.name: two_primaries_take_the_tighter_window
scenarios.note: test_databoard.py: two rank-0 sources, the window is the min of their timeouts; ON the window is fresh, one ms past is not

scenarios.name: window_follows_the_lowest_rank_tier
scenarios.note: the window is the tightest timeout of the lowest-rank tier, tracked as sources register: a lower tier resets it, the same tier takes the min, a higher tier leaves it; timeout 0 is the 1 s default

scenarios.name: reregistration_keeps_the_tier
scenarios.note: plan B quirk: re-registering the primary at a worse rank re-sorts the channels but keeps the tier rank and its window (a setup retry re-registers at the same rank, which changes nothing)

scenarios.name: born_stale
scenarios.note: a channel that never pushed is never fresh and has no value: an unpushed primary hands over to a pushed backup, recent() and latest() answer nothing

scenarios.name: a_window_past_one_second
scenarios.note: a GNSS-only tier at 2000 ms with a 5 s backup below it: the shared window is 2 s, all of it fresh, and not a microsecond more; recent() with a driver probe window (3 x a 500 ms period). Every source pushes before the first query: plan B is born stale only under windows up to 1 s

scenarios.name: fresh_below
scenarios.note: fresh_below(rank): a source with a LARGER rank number, fresh in the shared window; equal ranks and stale ones do not count

scenarios.name: stamp_follows_the_primary
scenarios.note: stamp(): the primary push time, for change detection; a backup push does not move it, and it holds while the primary is stale

scenarios.name: recent_reads_back_its_own_channel
scenarios.note: recent(window): a provider vouching for its own number (a baro re-zero); its own window, not the parameter one; latest() is any age

scenarios.name: position_handover
scenarios.note: a fix as integers (1e-7 degrees): passed through exactly, the HITL sim outranking the GNSS while fresh

scenarios.name: values_pass_through_bit_for_bit
scenarios.note: pressures at sea level with full f32 mantissas (101325.37 Pa is 101325.3671875 in f32): every one comes back bit for bit through read, recent and latest; a backup reads raw, since this parameter does not reconcile

scenarios.name: vectors_pass_through_bit_for_bit
scenarios.note: unit-vector components with full f32 mantissas: every word of every vector comes back bit for bit

scenarios.name: reconcile_learns_and_corrects
scenarios.note: test_databoard.py (the backup pushed BEFORE the primary, so both sides learn from the same reading; the rounds a look period apart): while the primary is fresh the backup bias is learned (EMA 0.1); on handover the backup reads bias-corrected

scenarios.name: reconcile_looks_once_per_period
scenarios.note: the port learns at most once per look period (500 ms, warmstart's pad poll: plan B's flown rate), however often the primary pushes: pushes inside the period teach nothing even with the backup far off, the period runs from the last look, and a handover corrects by the offset of the looks alone

scenarios.name: reconcile_at_pressure_magnitude
scenarios.note: a backup barometer reconciled near 101325 Pa: the bias is learned in f32 and a corrected pressure lands on f32's 1/128 Pa grid (within the 0.01 Pa tolerance)

scenarios.name: reconcile_freezes_while_the_primary_is_stale
scenarios.note: offsets freeze while the primary is stale; a stale backup learns nothing; a co-primary is never reconciled; the flag is set by a BACKUP provider; a primary back inside the look period is silent

scenarios.name: reconcile_skips_a_vector
scenarios.note: reconciliation is for additive scalars: a vector never learns an offset and its backup reads raw
